positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed and debugged core features for the OmniMetrix customer portal using Angular 14 and .NET Core, enhancing user experience and performance.
•	Collaborated closely with the electrical engineering team to integrate complex API endpoints and optimize data flow from electrical data.
•	Participated in code reviews, ensuring adherence to best practices and code quality standards.
•	Built a mobile application for Android and iOS using the Ionic framework, providing a seamless user experience across devices.
•	Diagnose and resolve software defects and issues, ensuring minimal impact on end-users.

positions.title: Data Center Support Engineer
positions.description:
•	SQL developer support in testing and deployment of code for data processing and reporting
•	Troubleshoot SQL stored procedure, view and SSRS automated delivery for issues arise by various clients
•	Maintain SSRS reporting data integrity by reviewing developer code during ETL processes, stored procedure, and reviewing client data
•	Liaison between internal teams and customer service interpreting technical and client’s issues
•	Implementation of Zabbix for system health and monitoring using Grafana dashboard as well as deployment of MariaDB for Zabbix
•	Troubleshoot and resolve server’s errors and abnormalities to meet SLA and OLA by reading logs, checking VM, restarting servers, and purging message queues
•	Research for new solutions to fix frequent issues by automation or code/script updates
•	Support various teams mainly production teams internally for data related issue via T-SQL
•	Resolve tickets with internal JAAMS’s system and escalation of tickets to different internal teams such as firewall issues, connectivity (VPN), and FTP outages
•	Troubleshooting of data processing and providing root cause analysis and performing software and scripts when needed to improve the process
•	Writing and maintaining proper documentation of all the critical processes and systems using confluence
•	Development of tools and application for monitoring essential repository files for production
•	Maintain active directory for user security levels and access

positions.title: Data Manager
positions.description:
Deploy Power BI tool for internal and external users to gain insight to information and financial data.
Project Manage the implementation of Azure and migration of data from legacy systems. 
Resolve issues from external partners in regards to system reporting and financials by finding root cause and creating preventative procedure in the backend. 
Manage the coordinate with internal management and third party to further gain insight of the business. 
Development of internal applications to improvement efficiency for internal users.
Develop an internal storage and security for daily backups for all sensitive documents.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
Summarizes current financial status by collecting information; preparing reports.
Substantiates financial transactions by auditing documents.
Guides accounting clerical staff by coordinating activities and answering questions.
Reconciles financial discrepancies by collecting and analyzing account information.
Secures financial information by completing data base backups.
Maintains financial security by following internal controls.
Prepares payments by verifying documentation, and requesting disbursements.
Prepares special financial reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing account information and trends.
Maintains customer confidence and protects operations by keeping financial information confidential.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description: I assist with manual import and export processes from various systems. I performing quality checks against existing data via Excel or any other software. I generate and manipulate data in applications such as Tableau, Power BI, and SSRS. I write SQL queries upon request and work on SQL server reporting services (SSRS).
